Method of Attack: Creates a symlink from a writable Steam registry subkey to a secure registry key to modify service executable path
Abuses Steam Client Service to launch a program with elevated SYSTEM privileges
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Steam Client Service registry permissions and symlink manipulation
Restarting Steam Client Service to trigger execution of modified executable
Indicators of Compromise: Symlink creation in registry keys under HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Valve\Steam\Apps
Modification of HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Steam Client Service executable path
